command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

# spawn runs task commands under bash -e and `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it
# (spawn#707), so errexit is off and every status is checked by hand.

echo "== the aligners must be the ARCHITECTURE they claim =="
# aarchbio#66: this image once shipped x86_64 diamond and bowtie2 inside an arm64 image,
# because the noarch humann package carries its own copies and overwrote the correct
# linux-aarch64 ones. Rebuilt and verified -- an x86 binary could not print a version here.
diamond --version 2>&1 | head -1 | sed "s/^/  /"
bowtie2 --version 2>&1 | head -1 | sed "s/^/  /"
uname -m | sed "s/^/  uname	/"

echo "== HUMAnNs OWN test suite: 186 author-written assertions =="
# This is the correctness claim. The committed demo_genefamilies.tsv is NOT usable as a
# reference here -- see the README -- so the verification comes from the authors' suite
# rather than from a number we cannot reproduce (practices/reference-from-tests.md).
T0=$(date +%s)
humann_test > unit.log 2>&1; UNIT_RC=$?
T1=$(date +%s)
echo "unit_rc	$UNIT_RC"
echo "unit_wall_s	$(( T1 - T0 ))"
NTESTS=$(grep -aoE "^Ran [0-9]+ tests" unit.log | grep -oE "[0-9]+" | head -1)
echo "unit_tests_run	${NTESTS:-0}"
grep -aE "^OK$|^FAILED" unit.log | tail -1 | sed "s/^/  verdict	/"
test "$UNIT_RC" = "0" || { echo "HUMAnN unit tests failed"; tail -25 unit.log; exit 1; }
test "${NTESTS:-0}" -ge 180 || { echo "only ${NTESTS} tests ran; expected >=180"; exit 1; }

echo "== and the tool-level functional tests =="
humann_test --run-functional-tests-tools --bypass-unit-tests > func.log 2>&1; FUNC_RC=$?
echo "func_rc	$FUNC_RC"
test "$FUNC_RC" = "0" || { echo "functional tool tests failed"; tail -20 func.log; exit 1; }

echo "== a real end-to-end run on the bundled demo =="
D=$(python3 -c "import humann,os;print(os.path.dirname(humann.__file__))")
DEMO="$D/tests/data/demo.fastq"; CH="$D/data/chocophlan_DEMO"; UR="$D/data/uniref_DEMO"
echo "demo_reads	$(( $(wc -l < "$DEMO") / 4 ))"
# --bypass-prescreen is REQUIRED, not chosen: HUMAnN probes `metaphlan --version` and
# parses the LAST line, but MetaPhlAn always appends a database status line there -- a
# warning when absent, 'Installed databases:' when present. So no database fixes it, and
# the prescreen is the only step that needs MetaPhlAn. Measured both ways; see README.
T2=$(date +%s)
humann --input "$DEMO" --output out --threads "$(nproc --all)" --bypass-prescreen \
  --nucleotide-database "$CH" --protein-database "$UR" > humann.log 2>&1
RC=$?; T3=$(date +%s)
echo "humann_rc	$RC"
echo "humann_wall_s	$(( T3 - T2 ))"
test "$RC" = "0" || { tail -30 humann.log; exit 1; }

echo "== the three outputs must exist, be non-empty and be the right shape =="
OK=1
for f in demo_genefamilies demo_pathabundance demo_pathcoverage; do
  p="out/$f.tsv"
  if [ -s "$p" ]; then
    N=$(grep -vc "^#" "$p")
    printf "  %-22s %6d rows\n" "$f" "$N"
    test "$N" -ge 2 || { echo "  $f has $N rows"; OK=0; }
    head -1 "$p" | grep -q "Abundance\|Coverage\|RPK" || { echo "  $f header unexpected: $(head -1 "$p")"; OK=0; }
  else echo "  $f MISSING or empty"; OK=0; fi
done
test "$OK" = "1" || { echo "output shape check failed"; exit 1; }

echo "== UNMAPPED is an accounting row HUMAnN must emit =="
# Every read is either assigned to a gene family or counted as UNMAPPED, so its presence
# is a structural property of a complete run rather than a band on a value.
grep -q "^UNMAPPED" out/demo_genefamilies.tsv || { echo "no UNMAPPED row -- run was not complete"; exit 1; }
grep -aE "^UNMAPPED" out/demo_genefamilies.tsv | head -1 | sed "s/^/  /"

echo "== determinism: the same input twice must give byte-identical gene families =="
humann --input "$DEMO" --output out2 --threads "$(nproc --all)" --bypass-prescreen \
  --nucleotide-database "$CH" --protein-database "$UR" > humann2.log 2>&1
echo "  second_rc	$?"
if cmp -s out/demo_genefamilies.tsv out2/demo_genefamilies.tsv; then
  echo "determinism	byte-identical across two runs"
else
  echo "determinism	DIFFERS between runs"; diff <(head -40 out/demo_genefamilies.tsv) <(head -40 out2/demo_genefamilies.tsv) | head -10; exit 1
fi

{ printf "diamond	%s\n" "$(diamond --version 2>&1 | head -1)"
  printf "bowtie2	%s\n" "$(bowtie2 --version 2>&1 | head -1)"
  printf "unit_tests	%s passed in %ss\n" "${NTESTS}" "$(( T1 - T0 ))"
  printf "humann_wall_s	%s\n" "$(( T3 - T2 ))"
  grep -vc "^#" out/demo_genefamilies.tsv | sed "s/^/gene_families	/"
  echo "determinism	byte-identical"; } > humann-diag.txt
cp out/demo_genefamilies.tsv .; cp out/demo_pathabundance.tsv .; cp out/demo_pathcoverage.tsv .
echo "HUMANN OK"
